title: Postseal gate permits seed host pair replay
evidence: Real Seed996 raw audit pair passes validate_root_witness under only in-memory phase/reviewrefs/created time metadata overlay. Actual call/output time is never compared to reviewed_at; neither host ref nor call ID is required to differ from seed. Original args are not compared to actual host input. Source seed-after-review also passes time helper contrary to contract.
fix: Bind paired original call args and parsed actual result to qualification/cutoff/Canon/review triple. Require distinct actual host call after review seal; compare actual call/output timestamps, not witness declaration time. Bind exact qualification ref and pending/current ordinal to actual Root host result; independently qualify legacy exits. Keep null unknown.

additional_counterexample.title: Seed qualification exits are not tied to original audit output
additional_counterexample.evidence: For original 967, actual_outer_exit 1 to 0 and actual_native_exit null to 0 both pass validate_qualification. First four pending rows have no exit fields. Root witness never compares output qualification_ref/next_original with witness qualification_ref/next.
additional_counterexample.fix: Bind exact qualification ref and pending/current ordinal to actual Root host result; independently qualify legacy exits. Keep null unknown.

title: Append-only qualification cannot pass fresh continuity
evidence: Qualification binds every row diagnostic_source_ref to current source_pending_ref. Adding ordinal 996 requires new pending ref, but continuity compares entire old row dicts, rejecting exactly this required ref change.
fix: Compare immutable event identity/exits/completeness/description per common ordinal; validate new diagnostic container reference separately and allow append-only new rows.

title: Mandatory nested Canon refs make check and activate fail before transaction
evidence: The exact Seed996 witness canonical_refs contains CP369/OW173. register expands witness/qualification embedded_refs then calls held_guard(exclude_pair=True), which deterministically raises CANON_PAIR_ONLY_TRANSACTION.
fix: Partition mutable CP/OW from immutable held source pins consistently after transitive expansion; preserve current-pair exact checks and transaction-owned compare-and-update locking. Do not omit all transitive pin protection.
